batch_engines.reason: The verified delivery includes a statewide municipal-zoning spatial join for all 14,130 parcel records. Ordinance text, use-table interpretation, dimensional exceptions, overlays, and entitlement rules are not yet computationally normalized.
Assessor owner names and owner-to-parcel edges are loaded. Secretary of State filings, principals, parents, and beneficial ownership remain unconnected.
Assessor latest-sale and book/page observations are not a complete deed index or instrument collection. No approved Cumberland land-record bulk collector is connected.
No approved mortgage, assignment, release, UCC, or lien bulk collector is connected.
The generic assembler groups exact normalized situs addresses with explicit parcel decisions. Deed collateral, shared ownership, adjacency, easements, and subdivision plans are not yet incorporated.
No approved Cumberland permit, planning, variance, or certificate-of-occupancy bulk collector is connected.

RIGIS parcel attributes provide impervious, developed, forest, aquifer, groundwater recharge, and public-water-supply screens. FEMA flood, NWI wetlands, natural-risk, soils, elevation, and EPA proximity run through the generic national adapter at activation.
Legal frontage, curb cuts, access rights, transit, and utility capacity are not precomputed in this pilot.
